data.content:
Comprehensive match preview of Roma vs Real Madrid as the Champions League returns after a long international break. We talk tactics, team news, form and more.

crest

Roma vs Real Madrid will kick off on 14 Oct 2026 at 15:00 EST and 20:00 GMT.

## Roma welcome an old friend to the Olimpico

Roma are back in the Champions League for the first time in six years, and their first home match is against former boss Jose Mourinho, a man who led them to UEFA Conference League glory in 2022. [...] Mourinho is expected to deploy Thibaut Courtois in goal behind a back four of Marc Cucurella, Ibrahima Konate, Dean Huijsen, and Denzel Dumfries. Jude Bellingham and Trent Alexander-Arnold are projected in central midfield alongside Yan Diomande, with Brahim Diaz and Federico Valverde supporting Kylian Mbappe in attack. No injuries or suspensions are currently flagged for the visitors, though Vinicius Junior's red card against Villarreal may affect his availability for this fixture.

### Form [...] Gasperini names a projected XI featuring Mile Svilar in goal, with a back four of Gianluca Mancini, Mario Hermoso, Evan N'Dicka, and Wesley. Marten de Roon and Manu Kone are set to anchor the midfield, with Matias Soule, Paulo Dybala, and Devyne Rensch operating ahead of them and Donyell Malen leading the attack.
